---
name: Feedback - bug, tool improvement or new feature
about: One workflow for findings from a tool call or work session
---

Use English and generic or synthetic examples. Remove credentials, private project data, identifiers and raw logs. Report vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md.

The [reporting skill](https://github.com/FloStyle/TurboMCP/blob/main/skills/turbomcp-session-report/SKILL.md) and [report format](https://github.com/FloStyle/TurboMCP/blob/main/skills/turbomcp-session-report/references/report-format.md) can help prepare a local draft. Review it before submitting. Search existing issues; use one issue per distinct actionable finding, not another copy of the whole session report.

## Type

Choose one: Bug / Tool improvement / New feature.

## Task and setup

What were you trying to do? Include TurboMCP version or commit, Unreal version and source/installed build, OS, MCP client and relevant public tool names. Write Unknown where needed.

## Observed behavior

Describe what happened and the smallest generic reproduction or workflow. Say whether it was observed once, repeated or not yet tested. For a missing feature, explain the current limitation or workaround. Do not present a proposed reproduction as tested.

## Desired result and impact

What should change, why does it matter, and what small example would demonstrate success? Mention any behavior that must stay unchanged.

## Evidence and links

List checks performed, workarounds and missing evidence. Separate memory changes, compilation and saving where relevant. Keep causes unconfirmed unless demonstrated. Include existing issue numbers and report/item IDs when available; otherwise write None.
